name: sandbox-sdk
description: Application-owned sandbox patterns and workspace file operations for Cloudflare Containers

scripts.check: npm run check:ts && npm run shim:check
scripts.check:ts: vp pack && vp check && npm run knip
scripts.shim:build: docker build --platform linux/amd64 ${SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA:+--secret id=extra_ca,src=$SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA} --target image --tag sandbox-tools:local --file images/sandbox-tools/Dockerfile .
scripts.shim:check: docker build --platform linux/amd64 ${SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA:+--secret id=extra_ca,src=$SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA} --target verify --file images/sandbox-tools/Dockerfile .
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run shim:check
scripts.test:package: vp pack && vp test --run packages/sandbox/tests/packed-api.test.ts && npm pack --workspace packages/sandbox --dry-run
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run test:package && npm run test:shim-mounts && npm run test:s3-e2e && npm run test:s3-lifecycle
scripts.test:shim-mounts: docker build --platform linux/amd64 ${SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA:+--secret id=extra_ca,src=$SANDBOX_EXTRA_CA} --target mounts --tag sandbox-tools-mounts-test --file images/sandbox-tools/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm --privileged --platform linux/amd64 sandbox-tools-mounts-test; status=$?; docker image rm sandbox-tools-mounts-test >/dev/null 2>&1; exit $status
